The diary consists of 9 steps, helping you identify and work through your cognitive distortions. - Daily Diary — record your thoughts freely with analysis and recommendations from AI. - Coping Cards — note down your destructive beliefs in coping cards format and work through them conveniently. 📘 Studying Psychology We have developed a series of interactive courses on topics such as depression and mental health. Thanks to our educational materials, you will understand the basic principles of CBT and learn how to work properly with a thoughts diary. Learn what terms like: panic attack, emotional intelligence, positive thinking, burnout, adhd, eating disorder (ED), and others mean. 🤖 AI Psychologist Assistant Throughout your journey, your personal AI psychologist will accompany you. It will suggest the best exercises based on your condition and help rephrase negative thoughts. 📊 Mood Tracker Twice a day, you can assess your mood and note predominant emotions. This way, you can track changes in your well-being and maintain a mood diary. The mood tracker is an incredibly effective tool for anxiety. Using it in conjunction with psychological tests and a mood diary will help to track the dynamics of the condition and improve mental health. Depression, neurosis, anxiety, burnout, panic attacks — unfortunately, these issues are familiar to everyone. That is why we started developing our product. Our goal is to create the best self-help app on the market. We position the app as "your personal psychologist" for self-help. Our AI assistant will support you on the challenging path to psychological health. In addition, you will find affirmations and reflective questions in the app. You can share your experiences with others. Our methods are based on proven principles of cognitive behavioral therapy, one of the most effective psychotherapy methods. With our app, everyone can become their own psychotherapist, gain self-confidence, improve mental and psychological health, and overcome anxiety disorders and depression. We have developed the best CBT app on the market, in it you can work through your automatic thoughts, get rid of anxiety and depression. This app can become your personal CBT coach. Self-help and self-reflection are an important part of working with a psychotherapist. It is clear that psychological help is needed on a regular basis. Psychology can be very costly financially. This is why our project (Mental Health) focuses on self-work with thoughts and cognitive distortions.

reviews.content: cute app. concept is nice. but for people who really need help and have a limited income or don't have digital forms of payment this is not the app for you. it's $6 a month base program and most of the features are locked behind a paywall there is a 3-day free trial however unlike many other apps this one didn't fancy me enough to take the risk. I did not feel that the risks outweigh the benefits. I did not want to ask a family member to use their digital form of payment. I'll stick with Finch!

By far one of the best purchases I have ever made. There are no ads, confidentiality is guranteed, and the AI features are neat. I haven't used it for too long, but it has helped tremendously with cognitive awareness, and relief from stressful events. My only real complaint is that the app feels a bit lackluster, as if it's not finished. I hope to see more things added, and I recommend buying the subscription if not simply to support the team!

I find it incredibly unfair you have to pay to access even a single AI tool. Those trying to find help in apps like these tend to be unable to afford proper mental healthcare and making people pay to use even one AI generated response should be criminal. Beyond that, while the articles are informative, the tasks are incredibly simple, and many required a separate note taking source. Why not include that in the app?! that's just thoughtless. Overall, I could get better therapy from my cat :/

I'm enjoying the app so far, I cant afford to carry on after my 3 day trial but from what I have seen it seems to be a nice app that helps me compartmentalise certain feelings. I will definitely pay for the subscription as soon as I am able to. I like the fact that there is an AI side to this because sometimes I struggle to put words into feelings and 99% of the time it is correct. Thank You!

I love your app, I checked it out because I ve also gone through things and I got the idea of developing my own wellness app,and i just bumped into yours during the development, its very good i tell you and i also got some things i could also improve on my own app,also got features i can include in my own app.Thank you very much for this, you are making changes to people's lives and i also hope i can do that, mental health can be taken lightly but it is very important in our everyday lives.

I find this app to be full of great lessons and helpful information.. by far the BEST mental health app available, in my opinion. there is so much information and endless categories/topics.. great job guys! I highly recommend making this app part of your daily routine.
Not super great if you actually have issues that you want to work on. It's very repetitive and you could probably do the same thing by just using any AI tool such as Gemini. has not helped me

I've been using it for 12 days, and it is of great help. Of course it's also important to conciliate your experience with the app and professional feedback, but it has helped me a lot with anxiety symptoms and mood tracking. Great articles and dynamics. I hope it keeps getting better with the updates!

A great app to buy while it's still a one off payment, as no doubt it will continue to develop once it's subscription based. The AI support to balance out automatic thoughts are very helpful, especially if you struggle with this - it's as close as you'll get to having someone else give you a more balanced perspective, which I've found invaluable. In future, support for designing and carrying out behavioural experiments or graded exposure would be great.

Impressed! I was on the hunt for some DIY cognitive behavioral therapy questions and found this app. I have been trialing it for a couple days and like what I have seen thus far. I have experienced CBT before with a therapist. It is a modality and technique that works well for me. The AI is impressive and the price seems reasonable. There is really nothing to lose so I'm buying a subscription for the year.

I'm loving this app. It takes CBT and breaks it down into a study and the excercises into feasible, actionable steps that anyone (of any ability) can approach— without feeling overwhelmed. And yeah, I'll be honest, the study material can 'seem boring' for those of us, like myself, with a limited attention span, but take little breaks— to break up boredom. It's not the app— it's your brain needing a break. Take a break if you need one and get back to it! The app guides you. Do this for you!✊😊🧠

new review; the AI coach is usually spot on with the analysis and recommendation, I love that and it feels like I'm dealing with an IRL therapist. I wish there was a way to save the AI recommendations if I wanted along with my comments. I really feel the app is helping me!
No ads, keeps record of my mood, and honestly, genuinely helps.

I don't know much about this app, but .....from my little experience, over the past few days this app helped me. Also I like the features of this app. and overall this app is amazing. this app is much easy to use and can create a positive impact on a person's life.
Provides a very useful record of my moods - am and pm, plus it has very good tests for different emotional states, and include their explanations. It's a good learning experience!

I have only used it for a few hours to check if i want to recommend it to clients. The suicide sections was hopeful. I do think that the word 'committed' when you speak of suicide is outdated. It refers to when suicide was a crime.
this app is so perfect. so so so perfect. I will recommend to the developers to add audio lessons so that it will be easy for the audience also add visuals and lunch in more languages . thank you
This is my first time using this app i just shared my one problem and I am not sure about subscription plan right now

just started using it , looks promising , will update my review after using it for a few months. I found a bug though and would appreciate if its fixed soon. In the automatic thoughts diary section, the keyword won't go away on clicking anywhere on the screen and it becomes difficult to go the next section which is quite frustrating 😑

it has been helpful for me in adjusting my effortless self loathing thoughts to self acceptance and this has had positive effects on my relationships with myself and others. a suggestion i have is to make the cognitive distortion list accessible outside the automatic thoughts diary, like on a page of its own, so it can be accessed while doing a 3 column exercise outside the app. apologies if it already exists, i haven't been able to find it outside the diary.
it actually help and it help like a friend but u have to pick premium.

Yay! Thank you so much for this app. It is so easy to use in times when I need it most. The layout is simple and quick to navigate, and there is lots of practical info to aid you on your healing journey as well. I'm working on CBT in therapy, and wanted something I could really apply these tools, and this app fit that need perfectly for me! Thank you so so much!!

Absolutely love this app. It's so thoughtful and well worth the subscription. It has really helped me see some unhealthy habits I have and given me different coping strategies depending on the emotional charge. This is the only time i have managed to journal and keep a journal. Clear, easy to use, and beneficial to my wellbeing 🩷 thanks developers, I appreciate you :)

The app is good in terms of CBT functionality. However in latest versions it made a step away in terms of UX. It takes much more taps to open thoughts journal and create new record. Moving through steps is also more slow and difficult now, as you need to close the keyboard each time to press the "Next" button. It got prettier, but less convenient to use

I really love this app. I was already familiar with CBT but this app is great even for someone that isn't. There is so much insight and material to learn if your interested to. And then there's the indispensable thought diary that has been instrumental in helping me to restructure my thoughts appropriately. Which of course has lessened my stress, anxiety and depression levels immensely.

I would have loved to have tried this app, as I really need to get my adhd managed. I have been spiraling since my mom passed. Anyway, I DL'ed the app, and was told a login code was sent to my email. For some crazy reason, the code is not copy-able from my email, and it is incredibly long. There are 3 digits in it that could be a 1, an L, or an i. I have tried many combinations with all three but I just keep getting "invalid code". You might want to fix that because I was ready to sign up!

This is EXACTLY what I was looking for. The automatic thought and diary tools are amazing, simply to use and the AI actually seems pretty helpful at recognising cognitive distortions. The course material and activites look realy good and compliment my CBT I completed through the NHS. The app is easy to use, constnatly updated and does what it says. Premium is a good affordable option but not necessary.

I love this app! A perfect combination with therapy for me and it's so easy to use. I'd love to see it develop more and maybe add a daily mood tracker. Love the new articles and the way you click through to read them makes them easy to digest. It's the only mental health app I've managed to stay using.

This is a really great app. I can tell that developers really understand depression and seem to care about actually helping people rather than just making money. The most important features are all available in the free version, and the paid version is a very reasonable price. Once I get back on my feet and have a bit more money I promise I'll get the paid version to support you guys. I'm looking forward to testing the AI. It's a great idea because it makes CBT a little bit less daunting

I started using this simply as a thought diary and found that to be great. The sections are clear and helpful and there are no intrusive ads! However it also has many other useful sections and I have now even begun to try out the teaching material

The AI analysis is incredible. It's just what I need when I'm having a sad or stressed moment and helps with genuinely constructive ideas. The automatic thought process is also incredibly helpful and has really worked to switch my thinking. I sent some feedback to the developers and they responded quickly, which is always appreciated.

Having used CBT myself for over 2 years now, I've been looking for a good app to recommend to clients and this is the best I've found. Great interface, really good explanations while keeping things concise, and some excellent features that address the main components of CBT. Highly recommended!

It helps a lot, after a couple weeks of using this app, I feel like I'm managing to make great progress. I use the free version, though I would spend money on premium if I weren't as poor as I am, even the free version is sufficient. I definitely recommend, keep an open mind.

I am so thankful for the people who developed this app. The journal for automatic thoughts and how it is structured does an amazing job at navigating your thoughts. While I found the custom coping cards provided a really nice resource for people like me who struggle with internal conflict. This has allowed me to communicate rationally to myself in a way that I know will resonate with my emotional self. Honestly, If I could rate this 6 stars I would.👏

Very helpful app Update:I have been using this app daily for about 2 weeks. For me, this has been life changing. It's like having my own personal therapist with me 24 hours. The AI part is extremely accurate.It makes me look at situations in a different light.Also, the educational part and the dream analysis are awesome.

The old app was neat, with a pleasant uplifting design and everything you may need: depression, anxiety, burnout, beliefs scale. Now anxiety moved to premium, okay, there's an eating disorder in premium, and, for some reason, ADHD test, but...no burnout anymore. It's hard to say why. The design is boring as hell now, and is similar to all thousands of other similar apps, and with how typical it is, there's no reason to choose this app anymore.

I've had a little trouble with the AI function, the first time I tried to get it to analyze some text I just got the processing screen for ages. Second time it came back to me in Russian, I suspect a confusion caused by VPN which was set to a Spanish speaking country so still a little odd. When I finally got a analysis i found it reasonably insightful, covers some of my blind spots. The rest of the app seems decent, almost like a virtual diary, quite tidy.

They don't throw a bunch of information at you, but teach you in a bite-sized, sometimes in a story-like way and only the main points. Although I just navigated through some of the features, I liked it so far.👍

I really like this app, but writing about deep and painful emotions made me relive these emotions, and though th AI response was adequate, I was left wanting a much warmer, empathic and embracing response. The AI gives a very neutral response. I guess it's hard to get the same experience as you would with a therapist, but I found it tricky because I wanted someone to challenge my negative thought patterns. It's great and I think/hope it could be improved. Maybe I'm wrong, but it's how I felt.

This app has helped me a lot. It has so many great articles and exercises that have actually helped me to retrain my brain. I have been able to do the work in changing my negative thoughts and beliefs with the help of the apps guidance

Paid for lifetime use and app will not unlock. I have my recipe and emailed code. This is a known issue that they will not fix as it prompts you repeatedly to pay again making you think your original payment didn't go through. There's no company/ developer contact information. I'm screwed. Somebody anybody please help.

This is a wonderful app. Thinking tools for life. Beautifully designed. It is made with such care and empathy. For example, the articles are fed in small chunks, tapping to add more. They provide real examples. The app also keeps design consistency throughout. So when you see and learn about, say, Automatic Thoughts, with examples, it's the same design cues when you go to do it for yourself.

Excellent tool. Looking forward to working w it. The negative for me is if you start a diary thought and don't finish it doesn't have a save feature. Still overall pleased as this the therapy my therapist is using with me.
It's really helps with my mental health..

really helpful app to keep track of progress over time with a simplified check in process day and night. the ai analysis is great too, breaking down what is happening with spiraling thoughts or triggering situations. premium is worthwhile so far but would use the app even if I couldn't do premium

The app itself is nice, something, which can replace CBT on paper. However, AI doesn't seem to recognize positive entries in the diary and tries to assign me a mandatory irrational belief. Can you please fix this?

This app is amazing & life changing. I started using it yesterday after developing depression over the last few weeks due to a few things suddenly going wrong in my life at once. I used to be sceptical about CBT because I think my emotions tend to procede my negative thinking rather than the other way round but realised using this app that it doesn't really matter. I have had incredible results already. It's so user friendly & the explanation of CBT is far superior to what I got at university

The privacy policy is unclear. For an app like this it's crucial. I still don't understand if and when anyone can store or read the things I write in the app (or test answers/results). I don't feel safe using it. UPD: Is the encryption only for the paid version? Is the text uploaded anywhere except the personal GDrive and to a therapist of choice? (e.g. in telemetry etc?) What about the AI - does it store the text anywhere? Please make it very clear UPD2: thanks! Will give it a try now!

I love love love this app, I only wish I could unlock all the features. so far though this app has really helped me understand my moods and how important it is to regulate my moods with the "check in" feature. it's just very helpful with teaching you about your mind and how to help change your thoughts I love this app you should try it out for sure!

I'm loving the bite size chunks of information. I'm dyslexic and it really helps me to remember everything with the question at the end I can feel it sinking in. I even noticed after a week I'm picking up on my negative thoughts and feelings and I've been able the change them to something slightly more positive. im clean off drugs 10 yrs suffered alot of trauma on the streets if you can help me wow you can and will be amazing. thanks from all the ppl like me. so much gratitude.

title: Thoughtful: AI Mental Health
description:
Thoughtful is private, and always available. Chat anytime with an AI designed by experts. Practice skills, find perspective, and take a pause when you need it.

Conversations with Thoughtful are unlimited and available 24/7. Use it for a quick check-in or a longer conversation. Sessions draw on established mental wellbeing practices, with simple exercises and clear next steps you can try right away.

Thoughtful is built by clinicians, researchers, and builders who believe high-quality support should be available when people need it most.

Important to know: Thoughtful is an AI mental wellness support tool. Please remember, Thoughtful is not a human therapist and cannot provide medical advice or diagnose conditions. Thoughtful is not a replacement for therapy. It’s not designed for crisis. If you are in crisis, please call emergency services or visit findahelpline.com for resources.
