reviews.content: For a free app this is great, especially for tracking stress and mood. I also like that there are podcasts and more basic meditations. I do think they need to be separated though as one of the podcasts turned into a meditation which was not what I was looking out for at the time, maybe a separate category for this would be useful. One thing I think may be dangerous for some people (especially with EDs) is categorising your meals as good, okay, and bad. There is nuance to nutrition.

Out of about a dozen mental health care apps I've tried, this is hands down the best! Free to use. No paid versions. No ad pop ups. Just pure helpful info at your fingertips 24/7. This is the only app I can recommend to anyone looking for any level of mental health care, regardless of where you are in your personal journey. (There's even a fair bit of physical care/exercise info & routines included.)

I enjoy it so far. it's been three days. Today I didn't follow though with the night routine, but it's my Saturday. I wish there was more videos to listen to, and perhaps a little bit more on sleep procrastination. One of my major problems is knowing that I need sleep. However, I tend to "buy back time". I also would love a routine check list, for bedtime not just the morning after. "Don't forget to do these items before sleep. " That would help me out tremendously. I really do love it so far.

While I've loved this app for a while, all of a sudden the tracking data has become corrupted... it's put entire weeks of mood and sleep logs under the same day. They don't let you make logs more than 3 months prior, meaning I can't even manually fix all the logs, and they don't even provide a way to fix the date of sleep logs so... I'm just stuck with that corrupted data. The only option I have to fix that is to fully restart/reset the app and lose all my data. Disappointed and discouraged.

Highly recommend to anyone who needs help with mental and physical health tracking and aid. Wonderfully put together, easy to use, and has basically everything you could want in a health app. If you are thinking about it definitely try it out!!! Has something for everyone and I find myself using most of the features daily to help me out and learn more about myself! Only flaw is I wish on the mood tracking part you could customize the emotions that you are feeling more than the premade ones

This has been excellent alongside therapy to track my daily habits and notice patterns of what may be causing Distress throughout the day. Also provides a lot of resources, articles, and check ins for free. No ads either. Honestly the ONLY mental health app I've used so far that I can say that about and I've tried quite a bit. There's also crisis resources if you're in need. Overall extremely impressed.

I love this app! I use it to track food & beverage intake, sleep patterns, moods & emotions, and physical activity. I utilize the grief journal, guided meditation, exercise videos, articles & podcasts, daily affirmations, mindfulness & grounding exercises, and more. I plan to start using the recipes, box breathing, and some of the series to help manage stress, anxiety, and depression. It has a section to help you reduce drinking & gambling, too. Any area you're looking to improve, it's got you!

As someone who is physically disabled, exercising or any prolonged physical activity can be painful, tiring and cause me fatigue throughout the day. I can go on the occasional walk and bike ride which I'm sure to log in the app but I can also put events that had a lot of walking, physical therapy, etc. I like that the app doesn't restrict you to specific answers in any of the journals/logs. I struggle with my mental health too and this app gives me well organized resources to guide me :)

I was surprised at how good this App is, and it is free. I enjoy the podcasts tremendously. I have learned a lot and discovered some resources I didn't know existed. The professionals that Gabby interviews offer compassion and understanding. Most of them offered good ideas, and even the ones I didn't fit with shared some useful stuff and talked about their own struggles with Depression and anxiety. I like the Journalling for 15 mins and the remembering to breathe exercises. Great App!

This app has been wonderful. There are so many features inside that I don't need anything else to keep track of my mental health. You can do meditation, listen to calm music, record your mood, thoughts, and so much more. Everything has also been free so far, which is great. It also has reminders set so you remember to open the app at least once a day. My favorite thing is how it has a few activities selected for you to do everyday to be mindful. It's been great so far and will continue using it!

I've been using it for a few weeks now and it's by far the best free mood tracker out there! I love that one can record as many moods per day as I want, I can add as many emotions/situations as I want, and record how my sleep was. I just don't like that i can't edit the moods to personalize it a bit more but still an amazing app. But if you haven't tried it you absolutely should!

I have used a few different mood trackers now and so far I think this one works best for me. The only thing that keeps it from being a 5 star for me is that the emotion options it gives aren't really versatile enough, so I find myself just picking a close one and not quite feeling satisfied with it. I would love to have the ability to add custom emotions like I can for most other categories. Other than that it is super user friendly and I find the included tools actually helpful.

Very user friendly. I don't think I've had a single add yet. Honestly if you're new to self help and care management this app is the best one I've used yet. Uts easy to figure out and the tutorial is easy to follow. Not frustrating. They've got a little bit of everything for everyone. It even has crisis hot lines. That's amazing. I've not used another app that gave you direct crisis hot lines. It's always been, hey are you in crisis? Contact a councelor. Then doesn't help you to. Amazing app.

I like this app a lot and I would give it 5 stars if it was a bit more inclusive. The questions are very detailed which I love however I'm vegan(for body health reasons). So I can't answer truthfully to health related questions. I also can't take advice from recipes or things that apply to animal derived foods. Other than that, I've only had this app for a couple of days but I think it's very pleasant. It has a lot of tools to help with my mental health.

This app is like my old couselors speaking through it. It is worth using. Especially if you have have some sort of stress or mental illness. Keeps you organized in what you do day to day. It even makes me feel some sort of 'accomplishments' knowing I can get stuff done during the week while keeping track. Look back n I did my best or how can I improve or do want to stay neutral n keep at it. It's cool

Flexible, not overstimulating or overwhelming to my ASD. Unless I want it to send me notifications it doesn't. There's no guilt inducing notifications that I haven't logged anything, just gentle reminders when I open the app. That's rare. I really can't express how good this app is at simply putting the power and tools in my hands to figure out what works for me and what doesn't. So far just having it available on my phone for use now and again is a form of stress relief.

I love this app. I struggle with severe depression and anxiety. I've tried other apps for tracking moods, sleep, ect in the past and this was so nice due to having everything in one app. I enjoy that it can send reminders to fill out stuff or when to put down my phone before bed. I would recommend anyone struggling with mental health to give it a try.

Oh my gosh. this is the best app ever! so many tools to help you with your mental health. I felt like mine was starting to decline, so I decided to download this. it helps with everything so much! you have an option to start a journal, and I decided to start one, and it feels like all my problems are off my chest. it's also FREE with NO ADDS. it's insane to me. this is the best free mental health app out there!

It's been helpful for me to refocus on myself and how I'm feeling at the end of the day. Writing down my thoughts, feelings, and experiences makes me feel like I'm being heard. Gives me a clear perspective on what's going on within myself. There are also helpful podcasts to listen to. The app sends notifications throughout the day, reminding upu to set aside a few moments in the day to check in and not neglect yourself. Very helpful to build yourself up and be there for yourself 🙂

I've been using the My Possible Self app since 2020. It has gotten me through so much since then. The best app out there for mental health, in my opinion. It's free and easy to use. I only have one suggestion, and that is if somehow the music can play while I'm using the app. For example, when I'm writing in my mood journal, logging my food & drink intake or playing games. I love this app so much. It has been a crucial part of my life.

This is a good all in one app Helps to track, monitor, assess, and learn about how to better improve your wellbeing. Mood, Sleep, Diet, Exercise, Water Intake, Diary, and others. The more you put in the more you get out of it as it is able to detect patterns and links to what could be causing your good and bad days, particularly when it comes to mood tracking. However, it doesn't go in depth with any of the other stuff. I want to track how many hours I sleep not just basic quality rating.

I love this app a lot. Comparing it to other apps made for mental health, i think that this one is the most easy to use and also has a really nice and soothing design. I really recommend trying it out if you're looking for something to help you on your path of improvement. P.s. The thing that surprised me the most is that you cand also find short workouts (yoga, cardio, bodyweight) One thing i'd add tho is a daily planner thingy, where you can set times for mental/physical exercise, meals etc

Update: pls fix the reminders for Mood Check! It doen't alert me anymore| I really like the yoga videos in this app and the mood tracker when I don't forget to check-in! However, is there a way for you to make the yoga videos downloadable and okay to play offline, please? It hangs right in the middle a couple of times and just ruins the momentum. I hope you can do something about making the videos downloadable so that others like me may use it anytime without the need for an internet connection.

I absolutely LOVE this app. It's easy to use, it has EVERYTHING and it gets constantly updated. I installed it to track my mood and my triggers, but now I use it for everything: I track my sleep, what I eat, how much I drink, how much I exercise. It also has great podcasts and advices. I use A LOT videos of yoga, pilates and fitness exercises. Aaand I just saw the recipe section was added. Not to mention it's completely free and without ads. Best self care app EVER.

This has to be one of the best life changing application. Everything is complete, you have remedies / solutions for sleep, depression, stress, anxiety, .. so much things. The daily tools such as food, sleep and food log are also great. I just have one issue ! Regarding the food log, the only available options are "Unhealthy", "OK" and "Healthy". But sometimes we treat ourselves, which is self-care or just a special occasion. I would love to see an option "Treat". Thank you so much for reaching !

The UI is GREAT. And I loved the introduction to the app. However there is A LOT of reading, especially in the modules and I found myself losing interest and just skipping most reading. Maybe the app could have voiceovers for each bit of reading, that you could turn on and off. Also, it's quite a cliché mental wellbeing app. It's not very original, and could probably do with some more stuff that makes it stand out from other mental wellbeing apps.

This is honestly the best app I have ever downloaded. I suffer from lack of motivation, depression, anxiety etc and this helped me so much. It's really easy to use and so easy to interpret the information as well. For example you can log your emotions so you can look back at a time where you felt bad and see how you overcame it for the next time. It logs your sleep schedule, eating habits, mood, stress levels and more. No ads as far as I know either! Really great app!

Awesome app. Unlike almost any other similar one it's free *and* you can easily export all your data (i.e. it doesn't lock you in). I wish it had one feature that is implemented almost perfectly (not quite) in Sanvello: thought journal with support for reframing (marking mental traps for phrases/words, rewriting the sentence bit by bit). Here the thought journal is very different and a bit confusing: it seems to be tailored for detecting repetitive thoughts instead of cognitive restructuring.

This app is a must have. It has everything you need to feel better. Mood journal are amazing, the 10mn thinking time is also great when you want to empty everything in your brain and do a good mental and emotional cleaning. And it's free. My only issue is that I can't edit anything from my mood journal nor delete it. Would be great if this could be fixed.

Love this app! Very simple but does the job and no annoying ads. I would like to see the app add a function for users to list each day's positive aspects to keep up positivity and self confidence even if a bad was tracked as providing a 'bad' or 'okay' mood. Sometimes writing about a bad day at the end of the day means you miss out on cheering yourself back up.

I personally love this app. I find that it has brilliant options for monitoring your mood, anxiety, depression, stress, food and drink intake, sleep, fitness... You name it, it has it. There doesn't seem to be any in app purchases ( or at least I haven't come across them) and has really helped me in working towards feeling more optimistic about my anxiety and my progress. Would definitely recommend this app

My go-to-app for mental and physical well-being. I use it for 1) Experience sampling (and seeing correlations between context, stressors, mood) 2) Exercise. Building fitness from scratch. Helped me enormously with learning fundemental movements of cardio. Now I'm regularly -almost everyday using cardio and strength trainings (Pete is a great instructor). The app also allowed me to try out other exercises like Thai Chi, yoga, pilates. Huge thanks to the creators and contributers of the app.

Liked the old system best. This one's missing communication skills, also the stress at work feels more aimed for those working in an office, not a shop or other jobs. I would like to have help on coping with memory loss/short term memory loss due to stress etc. Is it possible for us to be able to add more button on "how we feel". eg. stressed,

It's quite comprehensive, in that it gives you a lot options and activities to choose. I would be happier if it knew that I was retired so that it didn't keep asking questions about work. So in some ways it's quite shallow. It's 100% free with no adds, except one, the people behind it run the Priory Mental Health company and if you try to go deep, you end up with their telephone number and contact details. So it's a fishing net. But not a bad one! And there's a lot to it. I recommend you try it

The best app I have had that helps. Full access to the whole so and meditations courses and teachers and not expecting to pay. It helps you keep track of several things, my mood good and water intake and more. It helps me a lot when I need it out want to unleash the behaviors that are negative and learn replace the positive ones. I great so that genuinely helps you when you need it.

The BEST APP! I absolutely love it! This combined with "Finch" are my main mental health apps. This app is my journal, and much more. The design is cute but also simple at the same time. The fact that they have so much free things...lots of respect! And thank you! I also have other apps but only for meditation when I want to change it. Mindfulness and journaling make a big gor my GAD. Just one suggestion: Add a "What I am greatful for" option pls. I use "thinking time" for this now.

I rarely write app reviews- I had to write one for this app. I'm not very good at keeping journals yet I find myself using this on a regular basis. I enjoy the journal aspects of it the most. It allows me to track my mood patterns and a way to express any thoughts/emotions I have in a healthy way. I also find myself using the explore part of the app too. This along side with therapy has worked wonders for me. I'd 10/10 recommend it to anyone.

Great app! I'm using the food, exercise, sleep and mood logs every day and like how the insights are displayed. I keep finding more wonderful things like the exercise videos. This is such a tremendous wellness resource. I really hope this app can remain free as everyone should have access to all the wonderful tools and advice presented here. Thank you to everyone who contributed to this app.

It is really the best app I ever used in my entier life! It has every tools needed to relax and to feel better in many situations or subjects, all of it for free I am really thankful for that! It really gives you a feeling of having your own personal space, it is truly amazing, thanks for this app! However, I have just a little recommandation of improving, I'd suggest to add a way to listen to relaxing noises from the sleeping section while navigating through the app itself!

I'm pretty happy with the app. It has taught me a few ways to manage with certain emotions. The thinking corner is nice however I dont like how as I'm typing in a thought or worry, my previous thoughts and worries pop up again and again. It bothers me quite a bit and can even feel taunting at times. Maybe have previous worries or thoughts compile in something like a notebook that you can look back on if you'd like, and if your repeating thoughts and worries have them be highlighted instead.

Extremely good, would be 5 if it weren't for the use of Ai generated images in certain areas, such as the covers for magic swan & the dirty sheperdess, and more. There are other free avenues beyond using a image blender machine. Would also be a 5 if there was a more compact and analytical way to view ones mood beyond the 90 days.

I am genuinely enjoying this app and have actually remembered to open it at least once a day. (Which is amazing when you have ADHD like mine. Lol) I have been trying to reclaim my life after going through autistic burnout and severe anxiety over the past month and it has really helped me with getting out of negative thought loops! My biggest issue is with the videos. I really wish there was an option for captions and/or speed. :(

It was alright I guess. It did glitch out while I was listening to the sleep music and wouldn't turn off. Instead it played all of them at once. Also, not a fan of the fact you can't edit previous logs. And when I saved my food + drink it didn't save right. There are probably better ones out there. I wouldn't recommend this one.

When creating an account, rather then the app having a 'next' button after signing up, you have to go to 'log in', it shouldn't even tell you that you've created an account, which is annoying. Overall, though, it's an okay app. I do have apps that do the exact same thing that are also free, but this one is okay too.

I LOVE this app!!! 2024 has not been an easy start for me so I knew I needed something to get me through the days..and I didn't want to pay for an app just to not like it. so the fact this was free AND it does SO MUCH for my mental health is truly a blessing. if you're struggling with anxiety, depression, ptsd I can speak from experience definitely try this app! my therapist even took down the name of it to suggest to others!

Hi! I just want to express how grateful I am to your team for this amazing app. Thank you for helping a lot of struggling peeps to have a free access of all features to help their mental and emotional health. But I also suggest that you could also add a donation option so others can also lend even a small amount of support to your team whenever they want. Nevertheless, you guys are awesome.

simplistic. very linear. does not have enough suitable options for choosing what we want to work on. greiving is a valid issue to work on understanding.. and real life experiences. that includebexplorstion of love. fear. ego. doubt. patterns. flaws. in general this app is like kindergarten with a smiley sticker to say " good job".bits been disappointing.

Still too early to give 5 stars, but seems very helpful. Free knowledge and information on practically every form of self care known to man. I only wish there was more on addiction, not just alcohol and gambling. But every form- ranging from drugs, all the way to shopping, working, tanning, etc.

Learning my behaviors between depression, stress, food diary have been helpful. The app offers much more just as anxiety, sleep, and acholic logging. And support or suggestions for symptoms. I don't feel as lost with materials and tools the app has to offer.

It's helps me so much! I do have some suggestions! Since I am minor, gambling and alcohol stuffs aren't for me. Although, it would be amazing if you could add freatures like : " Reduce stress a school, in the food log : desserts! And last but not least, stuff you do on a day : what does it do to your health! " Thank you. Continue the great work!!! ♡

title: BetterMe: Mental Health
description:
BetterMe: Mental Health—an all-in-one app for your mental well-being, offering meditations, courses, and other tools.

Mindfulness is key to a balanced life, and BetterMe offers simple, practical relaxation methods for everyone, whether you're just starting out or already a pro. Dive into guided practices and start discovering your inner peace today—let's embrace the good vibes together!

Teaming up with mental health experts, we have used effective tools and strategies from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) to help you tune in to the world surrounding you. 

Incorporate mindfulness into your daily routine through guided meditations, stress-relief practices, breathwork, sleep meditations, and hundreds of mental health exercises. When your mind is clear, you concentrate better, feel inspired, and get more life energy.

Just a few minutes can really boost your well-being. Opt for quick breathing practices to set the intention for the day or longer meditations to soothe your nerves. 

Start your journey with BetterMe as you reduce stress, discover self-love, and enhance your mental well-being.

🌿 BetterMe Mental Health features:

• Step-by-step plan
Get your daily tasks for morning, afternoon, and evening. Each one consists of a breathing exercise or guided meditation and takes no more than 5 minutes. 

• Breathing exercises
Access a collection of 3-minute breathing sessions to shake off worry, stress, and anger. Practice anytime and anywhere—whether you're walking, taking the bus, or waiting in line.

• Meditations
Explore hundreds of guided meditations to boost mindfulness, recharge your energy, and fully embrace the present moment.

• Sleep stories and calming sounds
Relax with soothing stories and mellow sounds to enhance your sleep quality and unwind after a long day.

• Mix and match relaxation sounds
Snow Steps, Beach Waves, Birds, Cat Purr, Fire, Forest, Rain, and more—create an ideal atmosphere that aligns with your emotions.

Turn on our sleep timer to wrap up your evening on the perfect note. 

• Interactive Mental Assistant
Start a chat with your go-to advisor for emotional support and guidance.

Download BetterMe now and embark on your journey to a more peaceful, balanced life.

We offer flexible subscription plans on Google Play, so you can choose what works best for you. Please note that subscriptions automatically renew within 24 hours before the end of the free trial or the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your Google Play account settings.

ℹ️ BetterMe: Mental Health provides general guidance on relaxation and mindfulness. It is not designed or intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any health conditions. The insights from the app are not a substitute for professional medical care and might not be suitable for everyone. Before adopting any advice or activities described above, always consult a healthcare professional. Use this app at your own discretion.

Terms of Use - https://betterme.world/terms   
Privacy Policy - https://betterme.world/privacy-policy  
Subscription Terms - https://betterme.world/subscription-terms

reviews.content: Update: Now they continue to email me trying to get me to change my review. My review is factual, while they did cancel upon request, it wasn't made very clear up fro t this is a recurring charge. Agree with the others, it wasn't made clear this is a weekly subscription. I am pretty careful before signing up for anything. I don't balk at paying a fair price, I do take issue with it not being made crystal clear of an ongoing cost.

Wasn't able to actually use the app. While reading the reviews, and the responses by the company/creator, I was under the impression you could access some content for free. Wrong. You can set your goals for free, but then it takes you to a page to subscribe without any option off the page. Based off the reviews I was NOT going to sign up for the free trial or subscription. Sad I couldn't even look around the app to see what was offered.

Edit: The app has gotten better. Some issues have been fixed. Someone did reach out. : It has potential to be really good, however nobody responds to emails (I have sent quite a few) and some of the features just go away when you're in the middle of using them. Constant adds to purchase more. And there is no way to look back on your pass journaling. The mod tracker only offers thumbs up/down, no inbetween. The reminders are helpful, I enjoyed the articals as well.

I can't cancel, in google play on my computer and on my phone it doesn't show up in my subscriptions. I emailed them 3 times and they keep charging me. Used the app once. Trying to resolve it. Edit: They emailed me back, gave me refunds, and were genuinely sorry about the inconvenience. I think its not purposefully done. They said they were trying to respond quicker and more efficiently in the future, and they resolved it effectively. Write a review if you have this problem, they are very quick.

Its a decent app, but I had the same thing as other people. I thought it was a one time subscription, but after subscribing found it was weekly. I have cancelled and reached out to them for a different type of billing cycle. I also was not able to find it a subscription anywhere(in google play) or on the the website. But 9.99 per week is a lot of money. I was able to get the fitness and diet tracker for 19.99 for 12 weeks and updated to 19.99 for a year. Hope I dont have billing issues.

Neat app, and I actually don't think that having a subscription model is necessarily bad, but there's no 'alternative' or free model, (vs the free trial period); more importantly, the cost of the subscription is absolutely insane at $6.99/mo for six months in the form of lump-sum charge of roughly $42! The cost of using the app induces more stress than its exercises could ever relieve.

This app is a scam. They charged my credit card for $30 without me even realizing what was going on. This app is purposefully confusing in a way that you don't even realize you will pay whatever amount. And judging by the other reviews, they charge different amounts to different users..? Fishy, and definitely maliciously intended. I emailed them asking for a refund, since I was misleaded into a subscription I didn't want. Let's see what they'll do about it.

Tried a couple meditations but it's too distracting having a computer generated voice as the guide. Not a whole lot of material for the money. Speaking of money, don't waste yours on this app. The only thing I find interesting is the brain orgasm videos but even those are kind of lame. I can find similar things all over the internet for free! I downloaded because of an ad that claimed to help balance chakras. I see no mention of chakras anywhere in the app. Very disappointing. Want my $$$ back!

I have to exact same experience as everyone else. I was lead to believe that it is a one time payment of $9.99, and was then charged that amount again a week later. As soon as my very first payment went through, I checked my Google subscriptions to see if this app was listed, and it was not, and still is not, listed as a subscription of any kind. This is infuriating considering the app claims this is the way to cancel your subscription. Maybe once I get this resolved, I can actually meditate.

I just downloaded and started exploring the meditations, and I'm not 100% on if the observations I have are positive or negative. My general feeling is good, I like the voices (I might want to hear different meditations in different voices, time will tell), but the ending of the recordings seems a little abrupt. I also had to adjust volume between one recording and the next- not a big problem, but worth noting.

When signing up for the app it said i had a one time payment of $9.99. A week later I was charged another $9.99. Tried to email them no response. Look on the app and Google play to find ways to cancel. Did not find it. I contact the app and they managed to fix the problem and refund me the extra charge. Overall the app is really good way to start meditating and bettering your self.

Edit: Their customer service team has emailed me multiple times requesting that I change my review. Original: They have a "cancel subscription" option in the app, but it never worked. I had to contact customer support via email to initiate the cancelation. Even after opting to cancel, I received an email asking me to reconsider. Why even have the "cancel subscription" option in the app if it doesn't work? Seems like they make it difficult on purpose. Seems deceptive.

I enjoyed the meditation but 29.99 a month is too much for an app. Because of the price I'm more than likely not going to subscribe post trial. I have the tendency to download an app use it one time then forget all about it. Because I can't see the value of paying that much for non human interaction, I don't get why not start low and annually increase the rate based on usage. or something like that, or even subscription levels. The cost of food is too high.

Not really all that. Aesthetically, it's nice. Decent user interface. Too much $ for not enough content. Some ideas around it are good, but some things don't seem well thought out... the brain orgasm videos have several in a row that repeats the same music and the song makes makes me feel anxious. The journeys feature is okay, but the instuctor talks too slow. I have used a handful of other meditation apps. Insight Timer is much better and has a large community with way more medtations/classes.

Don't buy! It's a recurring subscription for $9.99, which they don't tell you upfront, just after you paid. It's filled with false advertising. You take a quiz and assume that you're getting personalized content from the app but there's nothing personalized about it. I also never got the food recommendations. The meditations are garbage, the man's voice is irritating and uses words that are not soothing. He also speaks too slowly. After emailing two different people I was able to get a refund.

Updated to add: a person did contact me and resolve the issue... Its kinda pricey, but the App itself is nice. It's relaxing, and I enjoy the meditations and the music. However, There is no personal subscription info on the app, only the general "your subscription will renew automatically at the end of the term you chose..." If you don't remember the term you chose there's no way to find it in the app. I have emailed them to find out and got an auto reply that a human will respond in 24 hours.

No idea what the app is like, but the customer service is horrible. I downloaded and paid before I realized that it's a $10/WEEK charge. I immediately contacted support via email several times, and attempted to call, with no response. I expected more from customer service: I want a refund, I want my subscription canceled, and I don't want to be goaded on and have my cancelation ignored, so that the company can get paid. Go to YouTube, or better yet, use the Calm app.

Separate your free trial from the paid subscriptions so that we can "try before we buy", and then I will update my review! If your customers truly like the app, then they will purchase the version of their choice! Don't make them cancel at the end of a free trial! Our lives are busy and you get paid if someone forgets to cancel their card! Don't put people through this! I want to try your free trial, but I don't want to give you my card info. I will buy, if I like the app.

So far a fantastic app I try the anxiety one that is free, it does a good job of relaxing also felt energetic as well, thought just adding my 2€ In to have more free choices or at less the ability create plans but at a minimum but too keep using it but of course, it leading up to add-ons or a more immerse experience that you'll of choice too buy a #plan ($.$$), ($$.$$). So I'll return with a more in depth review after some time too get a better feel for the app.

Scam. 1st of all, I realized it was a trial and there would be a subscription charge. Did not realize it was $17/week. Go to remove my auto renew through google play, but the app doesn't show up in my subscriptions area. Fortunately I could cancel it via PayPal. A $17 one time payment would have been fine, but they managed to scam me for $52 before I caught it.

Update: There was ZERO options to try before you buy WEEKLY. There was ONLY the subscription page not a click here for a free trial. We shouldn't need to email anyone to get the app up and running. You won't be getting my money. Original Review: You have to give a credit card before you can even use it. Find a different app that lets you try it 1st.

Scam. I thought I was signing up for one time payment of 9.99. Then found out I actually signed up for monthly subscription for 9.99/month. Turns out it's really 9.99/week. I emailed them 6 times to cancel (I was told I can't cancel any other way) and never received a response. I'm still being charged. Still waiting for them to be professional.

I was tricked into subscription. After paying 4 times for what I thought would be one charge, I contacted their customer service who canceled my subscription. They replied within 48 hours and canceled without question. The application itself is generally all right. Their customer service is good. Unsure why their business model includes duping people into recurring fees.

This app is the biggest scam. No way to cancel subscription. I would keep it if the cost was monthly, but weekly payments of $10 is just absolutely ridiculous and over the top. I am about to share a nice little post on ALL social media sites about the scamming of this app especially if I dont receive my money back or a way to cancel my entire subscription.

the app seems peaceful and maybe its really good, bit you cannot try it at all without paying. i clicked an ad for this app saying to complete a quiz, and i thought "sure i will try out a quiz. quizzes are fun and maybe it will be helpful". i wanted to just get into it as quick as possible, and it lets you get started without signing up, but thats not really helpful when you are expected to sign up for a recurring payment plan before you can even try the app and see what its all about.

They will charge you without your consent. I specifically only subscribed to their 7-day program which was $6.99. Nowhere on the sign up pages did I see anything about automatic renewals. After my 7 days was up, I saw a bill for nearly $30 in my bank account. What is the point of selecting how long you want to subscribe for if they will make that decision for you in the end? Why go from 7-days, to auto renewing someone without them knowing for a whole month? Seems like a way to money trap us.

When I bought the plan online by seeing an advertising, there weren't any information about period of the subscription witch I thought it's one time payment. After that, I found that this is just for one week, and in my opinion is too expensive. I emailed them right away to cancel the subscription and get the refund for the weeks I was charged, but still with no responses.

This is a scam.I downloaded the app thinking it was 9.99 a month. I was ok paying and trying it out, but it's honestly just ok. I've been trying to cancel and I can't figure it out. The app says to go to the app store and cancel the subscription, but there is no subscription listed now I was charged another 9.99 a week later. Don't do it.

Absolutely trash customet service. I signed up for the 7 day trial, attempted to cancel multiple times so I wouldn't be charged. Suddenly $40 comes out of my account. (The app button to cancel didn't work-press it and NOTHING). I look for a phone #-nowhere to be found. So I email the company and they say it appears as though I've already canceled. WHY did you take my money then? When I demanded a refund, all I got was an automated response about a progran extension. Make it make sense.

This app does not inform you that the purchase you are making is a recurring subscription and not a one time purchase. Highly unethical business practice and borderline fraudulent in my opinion. Do not download and purchase unless you are prepared to waste money weekly. ETA: Update - The support team was quick to respond to my email about canceling my subscription and getting me a refund. However, I still think their business model is terrible and needs revision.

The app contains some helpful tips but is basically multiple meditations a day so save your money. I don't care for not having some type of progress tracker and during the "microlearnings" your progress is not saved, I had to click through an "episode" 4x to get to the next. (The app may have glitched here, but annoying nonetheless.) Edited to add: The meditations use rapid breathing and harsh tones. The prompts need to slow down. Inhale, exhale, inhale, exhale. Tachycardia....

I can't access any of the meditations besides "anxiety". Anytime I do, the app closes. UPDATE 1/22/25 - Though I still can't access any of the meditations besides "anxiety" through the app, I must say the quality of the program is great and I already feel it making a difference. Also, customer service is awesome!

I signed up to receive the 7 day free trial, the next morning I had no access unless I paid. That is the first issue I experienced. NO FREE TRIAL! I willing paid for the $29.99/yr. I am looking for some type of meditation app. I then tried out the morning meditation and went OK for the first 3 mins then just shuts off. That's the end of the meditation. No transition, no bringing back to awareness, just shut off. The stark, computer voices are annoying and NOT comforting. Don't waste your money.

I was fraudulently charged recurring amounts of $9.99 and $6.99, repeatedly deducted from PayPal without my authorization. Only one set of these payments was refunded, and I have no ability to challenge the rest of the deductions apparently, as BetterMe claims I had some service agreement. Deceptive business practices. I recommend you stay away.

I paid $10 thinking that I was paying a one time fee for the app. Now I find out it's a subscription! I'm happy to pay a one time fee that is reasonable but even though you claim a 30 day money back guarantee, I'm told I can't get a refund. UPDATE... After leaving my 1 star review the company did refund my money so I raised to 3 stars but because of them not being upfront about their pricing I won't go higher unless they change their advertising to reflect the actual service cost

I don't remember downloading this app on my new device but saw it and tried the breathing technique for Anger. it was a 3 minute exercise. I did feel more peaceful in just 3 minutes. I think I will try the other ones for anxiety and depression. I didn't find a way to share this excercise with anyone nor pause the exercise. I'm sure it was intended to work on relaxing full 3 minutes. Then I saw subscription and left app. I already have too many subscriptions and it causes me anxiety and anger.

This is a really cool app, but NOT 40-50$ A MONTH COOL! I have read these reviews, and your response to some of them! I ask that you also find my "query" in your emails, and cancel this subscription immediately?! Really guys?! We all need great meditation in our daily lives, especially NOW, but we DON'T need to be grossly overcharged! Thank you very much. UPDATE: Situation was handled...subscription canceled. No refund. Maybe all of the reviews will change things in the future?!

This is a scam, I paid for the app and was charged again a week later. Nothing is said about it being a weekly subscription. I pay less for a month at the gym. Only way I was able to cancel it was through PayPal. The second charge was refunded to me by PayPal. I'm still out the $9.99 for the original payment and I didn't use the application, nothing made sense. Phone number listed on my PayPal kept disconnecting.

When I first downloaded the app I found that it was very nice, helpful and informative but my issue is the subscription and also sending multiple emails to try and reach them to cancel my subscription. I wanted to try the app as a one time thing but after I wanted to cancel my subscription I couldn't find it anywhere not the app, computer or even my phone. Also I even tried to sign into my account and it gave no options to help me. I hope they resolve this issue because I can't pay like this.

They steal your money! I've order it their upgrade package it never says that it's a weekly payment. So this folks has been charging me $84.90 every month. Becasue the $9.99 & $6.99 are weekly! And they never let you know! I'm beyond infuriated. Seriously $85 bucks a month? Not even LinkedIn premium I pay 35 bucks! It's a scam! Do NOT download it or buy anything on it! It's ridiculous the way they ripped off your money!

Shady! I opted for the monthly access billed at $12.99/month after a 7-day trial period. Instead, I was immediately billed $9.99 and then billed an additional $9.99 every seven days for two weeks! I received two 'Welcome!' emails which included a link for a complimentary wellness guide PDF I could download. The links only opened my browser, never the file. No trial, no file, AND you're triple billing me??? I cancelled with no regrets after the third charge to my account. Just wow.

MISLEADING!!! I just placed an order for the plan for $10 off Instagram. It was not clear about signing up for a subscription. I want a refund. For $10 it was limited for what was available. It's all very basic and honestly, you can find a guided meditation off YouTube for all free. Please give me a refund and to anyone considering, DO NOT BUY.

The microlearning is great, and there are loads of things to learn and engage with. I love that it puts you in control of what you want to heal, and it's self-paced. It's amazing what 15 min a day can do if you stick with it. Only 4 stars, though, because they say you have a mental assistant there, but no one responds (it's been 4 days). So that isn't useful. But thankfully I have my real therapist to talk to as well. Definitely worth the investment overall, though.

Guided meditation voices are obviously not real people speaking, they are computer generated and very inauthentic. The sleep meditation guy literally sounds like a robot, which is not soothing at all. The breathing exercises are useless because you have to look at your phone screen and read when it tells you to breathe in or out instead of an audio, which is very strange. I'm going to request a refund. I've used lots of meditation apps and this is my least favorite.

So the app was not for me. I just cannot get into meditation (sorry). The brain videos were very relaxing & enjoyable though! Anyways, I cancelled the suscription but not my card. The way my cancellation was handled was beyond amazing! So let me just say that any company that has customer service like that I FULLY SUPPORT even if the product isn't exactly for me.

I feel as if the meditation sessions are just too short, not as much focus on the chakras. My biggest thing is the voices for the guided meditations are horrible! Not relaxing or smooth, and it always makes me completely unable to relax. I do like the music you are able to listen to and the fact that you can choose different strategies for meditation!

From love I say- steer clear of this app until they are transparent in their business practices. I clicked in response to one thing (that was not reflected later), signed up out of curiosity as a yoga teacher trainer thinking one-off expense, found out I paid $9.99 for a 7 day subscription. Subscription that was not mentioned in the process. INAUTHENTICITY. If you really want to help people, better practices, please. Have rec'd refund, at least, via contact via Paypal. added star to my review.

The free version of the app is alright, but the reminders to pay for the premium version are very intrusive and pushy. It's almost as if they don't want you to know you can use the app without paying for the premium version. Getting past the "pay for a plan" pop-ups is counter intuitive. I understand the devs need to make money for their hard work developing the app, but why have a free plan at all if you are going to try and hide it from users? Just my two cents.

I don't want to say anything bad about the app. But the app builder tricks you into buying a subscription without making this clear at the time of buying. They will say it's all mentioned before paying, but I didn't see anything regarding the fact I was paying for a subscription. Not very transparent (I don't want to use the word dishonest). Update : they reimbursed me fully and swiftly. Thank you. I updated the rating about the app itself. Clarity when purchasing is still needed though.

It's terrible: after choosing your interests the first page that pops out it's for them to gain money. At least show us the product before imposing a "free trial" to which I had to click I accept to be able to deny the payment & finally see what the app is about. There's misspelled words, and please although not the majority want to gain weight, add a button for those who do. It's so frustrating to see everywhere how "lose weight" it's all they talk about. But rarely find support to weight gain.

title: Feelway: AI for Mental Health
description:
Feelway is an AI self-help app for mental health and emotional balance. Reflect by chat or voice, identify unhelpful patterns, reduce stress and anxiety, and build healthier responses.

Features:
- AI-guided conversations based on psychology (CBT-inspired).
- Visualize vicious cycles and find helpful thoughts and actions.
- Get ideas for your next session based on past conversations.
- Pattern analysis summarizes recurring thoughts, feelings, and next steps.

Privacy & safety:
- Your sessions are private by default.
- Feelway is for personal development and self-help. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment.

Focus areas & topics:
- Mindfulness and journaling reflections for more clarity about mood and emotions.
- Support in dealing with intense feelings, sadness, stress and anxiety, as well as recurring intrusive thoughts.
- Conversations and exercises inspired by psychotherapy, especially CBT-based approaches.
- Even if topics like ADHD or borderline are on your mind: sort thoughts, recognize patterns and derive next steps.

If you have a diagnosed mental disorder or are in crisis, seek professional help.

Terms of Use: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/22770342
Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/22770342/full-legal
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

reviews.content: I really like the idea behind this app – using AI to support mental health is ambitious and important. The app is on the right track, but some parts still need work, especially since it deals with sensitive topics. It should feel more intuitive and structured to build trust. Still, I’m giving 5 stars because the foundation is strong and I believe in its potential. Looking forward to future updates!

Feelway is a fantastic tool for anyone looking to navigate their emotions and break free from negative thought patterns! The AI companion is incredibly intuitive, guiding me through reflective conversations that feel personal and insightful. I love how it helps me identify and visualize my emotional cycles, offering practical strategies to manage feelings like stress or doubt. The app's focus on self-help and education, without pretending to be a medical solution, is refreshing and empowering.
I have tried the app, it looks very professional and promising and very detailed to me and I believe it could help lots of people who needs help with their mental health.
It’s like a friend who understands psychology. Talking to it can save you a lot of time that you might otherwise spend seeing a therapist.
This AI chatbot helps me control my mental health. I feel so much better after each chat session, it's better than a psychologist!
Overall a great app, with good user experience. There csn be different moods associated though, but yeah this solves the problem.
Amazing app! Really helps me reflect on my feelings and stay mentally balanced. Simple, smart, and supportive.
An interesting app that gives you a beautiful view of your emotions, it's definitely a keeper.
I really like the AI approach, very intuitive UI, love it.
Very unique use of AI. Works surprisingly well.
Really nice app, it's like having a therapist always with you when you need it
very helpful with an amazing UI and great UX experience!
very good app the whole app is very interesting
Awesome experience with this application
great app it's helpful
interesting app to try
Very creative app
Great app

title: Amaha: Mental Health Therapy
description: InnerHour embraces a fresh start with Amaha. A place to help you feel better and stay better, Amaha is built by trained psychologists and licensed psychiatrists. The app will improve your mental health, help you cultivate mindfulness, and sleep better through self-care, therapy, and community support. The core Amaha experience entails: - Self-help tools - Self-help activities - Easy-to-use trackers - Expert curated resources - The Amaha Community Get the Amaha experience InnerHour was your one-stop solution for everything mental health. Amaha is for everyone - whether you need a space to journal your thoughts, practice meditation to feel calm or are struggling with depression, stress, anxiety, sleep, or need self-help tools or professional support - this is the right place for you. You can begin your journey with an assessment that helps us understand you better. Discover a specialised mental health course based on your need. Each course has different tools designed to help you manage your sleep, and anger, tackle stress, overcome depression, beat anxiety, journal your thoughts, practice meditation and care for yourself, and feel calm. Explore self-help tools To help you ease your stress, become mindful and instill happiness, Amaha gives you an improved experience based on CBT, Mindfulness, and Positive Psychology principles. Keeping the InnerHour spirit alive, we can help you make feeling calm a habit with 500+ self care, mindfulness, and meditation activities - such as affirmations, guided journals and anxiety relief meditation audios. Access self-help activities Consistent goals, meditation, maintaining a journal, and similar healthy habits improve your mental health which lasts for a longer time. With the enhanced Amaha app, keep track of your journal, and align your schedule to sleep better. Such activities motivate you to improve daily, keep you calm, and reduce stress. Easy-to-use trackers Understanding your emotions and feelings is another essential part of your mental health and self care. Use the mood tracker to effectively mark your mood for each day and analyse it through a weekly mood chart. This will keep you aware of your daily moods and give you deeper insights into your mental health. You can then understand any patterns and find ways to work on them and keep yourself calm in different situations. You can also set daily self care goals on the goal tracker to add tasks that can improve your mental health and also help you accomplish more. Explore our Expert curated resources Amaha is built to help you develop a holistic lifestyle. Access our curated resources, including blogs, audio and videos, to understand the causes of different mental health concerns like depression, anxiety, and sleep. Learn different ways to stay calm, instill happiness, hot to make self care a habit, know the benefits of practicing meditation and how to process your feelings in a journal. Be a part of the Amaha Community A space to call your own and talk openly, the Amaha community is built to help you share your struggles and be heard. Join our groups if you are struggling with depression, addiction, OCD, or ADHD and can connect with people who might be dealing with similar mental health concerns. This is your safe space to share what's on your mind, anonymously. The Amaha (formerly InnerHour) app is free to download. A subset of our offerings is available for free forever. For any questions, reach out to us at support@amahahealth.com Visit our website: https://www.amahahealth.com

reviews.content: Found something better. I thought this app would help me fix my habits. For what you pay you really only get regurgitated things you really already know but are just ha info a hard time getting started. If that sounds like you, I would recommend an app called Fabulous. It's about $25 more expensive than this app, but it's worth every penny. It slowly teaches you how to change your environment in order to build better habits. It has different journeys that last about a month.

I'm using the courses along with a therapist (with another company). It's great to have something to do each day, keeping my inner healing of past trauma an ongoing process. The app has been easy to use, notifications are motivating, extra tools outside of the courses is great for rougher days and sharing the data with my therapist is what really makes this app shine. My therapist now gets an actual look into how I was each day between sessions and exactly where I need extra attention. Thank u!

So far this app is great! I've only used it for a week or so now, but even just tracking my moods and writing them out helps me release some anxiety. I find the guided exercises helpful in putting my negative thoughts into perspective. I've been recommending this to many of my friends. While it's not a replacement for a therapist, it's a great way to check in with yourself each day. I hope they add therapy sessions outside of India someday! I'm sure it would help a lot of people.

I like what I can see. The free portions seem helpful. I would be interested in more but it would be nice to try the 7-day trial without having to submit any payment info up front. The app could offer a reminder at the end of the 7 days if an individual would like to continue after the 7 day trial period. It honestly adds to my stress to commit to paying something monthly without being able to try it first.

This app is so helpful! You can create multiple personalized plans for the issues you deal with; there are many articles, activities, goals you can track, tips, and "inspirations." You can even talk to a therapist (for a fee), but the rates are reasonable. You can, however, talk to Ally, the "relief bot" and she offers articles, tips, etc. The only problem is it sometimes crashes when you switch between courses and then you have to miss a day of you goals. This is frustrating.

I like it so far, and I genuinely think it is helping me by teaching me ways to deal with negative thoughts, but I have 3 criticisms: 1. More interactive. I want to apply the skills immediately in-app. I liked the Perspective Taking module in the Self Confidence course for that reason, but the text fields should be long-form. 2. Customization. I want to be able to add my own daily tasks. 3. Audio accessibility. Articles should have an audio version to listen to. Otherwise it's been very helpful.

I wish you were more upfront about this being a payment plan service. I thought it was free with extras to pay for, but, that's not the case. The animations and design are good. I like the wording and color scheme. Please consider saying it's a payment plan up front though. Going through the surveys only to find out I had to pay to get the real help kinda sucked.

I love!! this app!! It's insane that an app like this is free and ad free (at least I think it is because I haven't seen a single ad I swear). The different exercises really help calm me during moments of extreme anxiety and sadness. I also love the daily plans and trackers which help remind and keep me from curling up in bed and ignoring the rest of the world. I also find the resources and information so useful! Today I learned about Facebook depression, which I've been feeling a lot lately!

I just completed one of the 28 day sessions, and I found a significant decrease in my stress level over the first two weeks, that then seemed to plateau and reverse somewhat over the final two weeks. At the same time, the last two weeks has been a time of heavy stress, so I can't necessarily fault the app, as the change around the midpoint may well have been caused by external circumstances. The exercises are short and, for the most part, easily doable. Well worth a try.

The content itself is okay I guess? But the vibe is kinda money hungry. The pacing feels like it's designed to stretch things to take up as many days as possible, to get as much money from it as possible. Additionally, if you miss a day of content it still doesn't unlock the next day. I made a mistake staying past the 7 day trial, (set yourself an alarm!) so now I have it for another month. Don't be like me. Save your money and read some articles online, for free.

This has been helpful and really enjoyable as a daily habit, and as a reminder of how to make anxious days or moments easier! it can be frustrating to not be able to edit daily entries or add missing ones, and sometimes a plan won't load without a quick app restart. but i love the format, it's accessible, organized and friendly. i also really appreciate how much content is provided, esp when a little goes a long way. i tried a lot of self care apps but this is my favorite to come back to!

I like it. It gives me a sense of order in my life. I can easily follow it and make sure that i sont moss anything. Being able to connect this to another device would be helpful, though. We dont always have our phones on us and we tend to go to other devices as well. If i was able to connect it to.. my computer, for example, I won't forget what i need to do and at what times.

this app works well. I set up to get a reminder every morning, which i like. The actions recommended by the app are *super* easy, simple, quick, so i do them, and it all adds up to have a positive influence. I tend to forget that having depression can shorten your life span, even if you have it under control, so the exercises in this app make me feel like I'm going something about that

It's an okay app and pretty easy to pick up. My only two complaints are that I can't undo when I did an activity especially when I know I didn't do the said activity then and that when you have more than one regiment being worked on, it seems to repeat the same goals which considering that not everyone does more than one at a time is a minor complaint. To me, it caused more frustrations than help.

Like the update so far. Wish the volume wasn't so low in the audios compared to other apps. More audios would be great. More activities would also be great; some indoor ones perhaps. The app is helpful and everything except the therapist option is free. I also recommend the Smiling Mind app, which is also free (+ non profit) and has different programs too.

I used this app for a few months and it had some tips and exercises that did help me a little. However, I felt that some of the exercises were very mediocre and text book, and weren't really helpful for more serious issues. I've done therapy for a while and was recommended some mental health apps, but this one doesn't give me as much support as I require. I think it would work well for some people, but for me its just not a right fit.

I think this app is wonderful! Well worth the one time, discounted price of $25 for a whole year for new subscribers. I love this app. I've been using it for about 3 days now and I'm really beginning to figure out how to get the most out of it. The daily goal reminders and tracking helps me stay on track and the new suggested activities daily really keeps things interesting. One can follow an entire stress reduction plan or any other wellness plan in just 30 minutes throughout the day.

Wow!!! I suffer from manic depressive disorder, anxiety, and severe PTSD. Focusing, and getting my thoughts together is often so difficult. Their interactive AI messenger and guided breathing exercises have helped me so much! I've only been using this app for a few days, but I can already see a difference! HIGHLY recommend to anyone going through a hard time, or anyone with mental disabilities!

I've just started using it but I like it. I wish there was a way to offer feedback on the app and exercises inside of the app. There is a cool tool called Allie. I wish it had more feeling options, however, like anxious, depressed, numb, triggered, or dissociated. I also wish you could rewind when listening to an activity like the breathing exercise or repeat the exercise or do another exercise without having to start over from the beginning.

Very helpful app for daily mental well-being. I like that it introduces you to different techniques and gives you the option to incorporate it. It also modifies your plan recommendations based on your periodic assessments and whether or not you actually like a technique. The downside is some days take longer because of article length/technique or calls for a different setting. The day isn't 100% done until you've done it in it's entirety.

Perfect for what I Need I am a little surprised this app is free because it contains so many great features! I have really enjoyed the articles and personal assessments they have! Sometimes it's hard for me to make sense of everything I'm feeling, so this provides a great way to keep track. I have already recommended this app to a few friends that I know could use the extra boost as well! I recommend using the "5 Minute Journal" with this too, it's worth the $5, and they go well together! :)

On for a hand full of days and I must say I am loving it. Stay motivated and keep doing the activities, it really helps. Using this in combination with journaling helps give at least some kind of direction for writing each day. I would only have one suggestion about relief bot. I understand it's there for low moments, but I was surprised when I saw you couldnt say you were doing well to it. I accidentally clicked it and the only options were the negatives or dont talk. Not big, just a thought.

This is a very calming app. I do, however, wish it let you pick multiple courses at once. I ended up going with improving my sleep, but I would have also liked to have been able to do the one stress as well. Overall, it is helping with sleep. I recommend to anyone haveing any sort of stress, anxiety, depression, and sleeping problems. 👍

(Please Excuse my horrible grammar) I have very deep anxiety and I usually have trouble trying to explain therapists or family members about how im feeling most of the time (especially with trying to give them an explanation as to why my anxiety lead up to the way it is now). It becomes very difficult to control and figure out ways to make it all go away for a short period of time. So, this app has helped me manage and keep control of my anxiety during family gatherings and work related problems

I love this app! It's really helping me with mood swings, and even my family has noticed. One thing I'd like them to add, is being able to overcome multiple things. At the begining it asks what you wanna work on, and you can only pick 1 problem. It would be really helpful if we could pick multiple! But overall, I LOVE THE APP! Even spending just 5 minutes on it can help a lot!! 🌸

This app has allowed me to take a big leap into dealing with my depression. That is not all though it also offers help for many difficult emotions and even anxiety and as I said depression. It allows you to set goals and it allows you to choose what you need help with. It can help with so many things and almost all of this is completely free.

I enjoy using this app. I would like to see more selection of moods and activities to choose from during the day. Like some kind of mood tracker and tracker for natural functions like eating, sleeping and leisure time. I like the reminders for daily exercise. I would like to have the option of reading the material rather than have it read out loud to me. It helps me retain the information better. Highly recommend.

I've been using this app for a few days now and am blown away. I struggle with severe anxiety and can't afford therapy. This app is like therapy in your pocket. It offers a *free AI chat relief bot (the first one I've come across), and the exercises / articles are genuinely so helpful. I love getting badges for progressing and Alice is adorable. This is exactly what I needed. I am already feeling better. Thank you Inner Hour! You are making a difference. 💞

you literally have to pay for everything. The basic courses they give you for free aren't that good either because they're incomplete behind a pay wall and aren't accessible for people who are HoH/deaf/prefer reading. EDIT: to further explain, nothing is written out in conjunction with the voice to make it easier for ppl w what i said before. you also can't go back and forth during the audio files, so u can't rewind if u missed something. very inaccessible on top of the pay wall.

I really like the app, but I'm no longer able to access some features like the Relief Bot. even though I'm on a stable wi-fi connection, whenever I try to use the Relief Bot it says "no internet connection". All my other apps are able to access the internet fine, it's just this one with the issue. This happens consistently across different wifi and data connections. Really disappointing :(

It's nice to talk with someone, but it also causes stress. The assess my anxiety test was incorrect about a few things, and after doing the test suddenly it had to be payed for too! This app is only for those ok with buying plus, because if you wanna do anything the might even help slightly, you have to pay. Yep, we have to pay for these things on an app we expected to be free, so if you can't afford plus it isn't worth it

I love this app so much its amazing! It really has helped me. I try to do the breathing exercises daily because it helps my day be stress-free :) but the only downside is that there is a lot of courses that you have to pay for. I feel like when it comes to Mental Health it shouldn't have you pay so much. But overall it's a really great app and I recommend it!! And I'm sure it's worth it to get the premium if you really struggle with mental health ❤

There is so much that you can do even if you don't buy the premium version. I was really struggling with finding an app that would help me calm down when I wasn't my best, and thanks InnerHour Self-Care Therapy, I have something that will help me calm down even if everything is going insane around me. There even is a relief button if you aren't feeling greatand it will refer you to excercise to ground yourself and bring you out of it. I really do love it!! Definitely a good decision to download!

A word of advice? do some market research. Your pricing is overly inflated and it made me uninstall it after scrolling through it for 10 minutes. Your starting price is 1400 or something, and with that you get typically 1 to 2 years of experience therapists. and for a more reliable one, with at least 7/8 years? the price jumps to 2800 to 3500. It's insane. Especially when you factor in the fact, it will be multi session, sometimes even weekly! you are operating in India, not the USA or the UK.

A smooth app, with a good team of experts aligned. An app feedback - please make it easier to find the invoices per session. Currently, to find an invoice, multiple steps are needed from the dashboard, then expert, then some steps. Not intuitively placed. Like standard design, request to link to the profile and accessible through the profile instead of linking to the expert. and have one direct button for that on the dashboard.
glitches like hell and the music for meditation keeps getting stuck at the same time no matter how many times you try to play it

Truly the best app in the world to tackle all forms of mental health challenges that could potentially come your way head-on. What stood out to me was the perfect amalgamation of incredibly smooth technology that lends itself to the world-class psychiatric services they offer. The best app created for our generation to resolve all emotional issues online. It's literally like Google for connecting with therapists and psychiatrists and the best surprise was joining a new community to grow together

This has helped me a lot during mental breakdowns and panick attacks. The guided mindfullness exercises, that specialise in different areas depending on what you're hung up on, are very good and don't take up too much time either. The mood tracker has helped me to keep track, and they funktion a bit like a journal, which comes in handy when I talk to my therapist. I haven't upgraded yet, but am planning to si ce the cost isn't much and the programs that you unlock look very helpfull.

My experience of therapy with Amaha was relatively poor. The process to join a session you've already paid for is needlessly complicated, requiring many steps that the team fails to communicate in advance. Even when you're struggling with these steps, nobody from the team comes forward to assist you, in fact, your timer already starts running! As a therapist, the expert assigned to me felt more like a salesperson for the first session than an empathetic therapist, maybe she was under pressure.

It has so much potential! Biggest problem is definitely that everything is only available online - even if it's paid for. There are a bunch of daily courses for different problems and guided meditation and diary writing that are very cool. The courses are too short though and only take a few seconds to complete. It would be nice to add a meditation or an article or something to make the days activity a bit longer. Over all it isn't too bad and does help if you use it properly.

I'm new to this app but I must say it has good qualities in helping you cope with your situation. There are so many method to try, the techniques, the breathing pattern (it's also downloaded, very useful when offline). Keep it up! And for those struggling, you can do it! Even if slow improvement count is a step!! Who knows maybe you're just a few steps away!! 화이팅!!

I really like it. It helps you improve specific things in your life, like sleeping better or anger management. You can do simple exercises to make you feel calm and refreshed. Everything about it is free except for the therapist, but that is something you can choose for yourself. There is one thing that could use improvement so far. When you do a simple exercise it just ends abruptly. Like no fade out or just the music for a few more minutes. I really think this could be better because it's just like "bham" reality. Other than that great app would recommend.
good so far. but finding slots is difficult

This app has definatley helped me a lot. I only had this for at least 2 days and its totally worth it. I have so many struggles and even depression, and this app is going step by step, a slow but reasonable speed to help. I highly reccomend it. You can even provide your own passcode so if people try to get in they cant. Also, the plus memebership is not needed unless you want your own "routine" based on your struggles, but personally for me I work great without it. Depends. Great app overall!

I use innerhour to help with anxiety, you know the type that keeps you up at night, it's really helpful, I only use it once in a while, but the tips and tricks really work! The relief bot is super helpful 😉🤖🤳 my only feedback is I would like to take programmes off, I was looking at the depression one for a freind and I want to take it off of my list.

It's a good idea for a wellness app, with some bugs. I like that you can add daily goals from the apps, wish you could access list of all goals available. If you end a program you can't go back to the activities of week 4 (bug). You can lose access to articles within a program (bug). Each day you learn a new skill but it's a lot of info, need to bookmark & go back to activities to practice. I did 4 programs in 2 months, no info on what I can still access when I stop paying for premium.

Very good app, high quality and helpful. Gives you a sense of calm and control. Good for anybody wanting to better themselves. I found the set up and little details very pleasing and think everyone sould have such an app. Also it gives you the feeling that you are talking or writing to an actual person. Lots of different courses in the free option as well. Overall , would recommend

Love this app!!! It can help you deal with stress, anxiety, depression, angermanagment, living happier and sleeping better. There are fun activities to help you with these things and even a cute little robot who you can talk to. There is a mood graph and when you select your mood, it goes really detailed(which I like). But my only problem is when I try to launch the app most times it gets stuck of the 'InnerHour' logo and it quite annoying when I really need it. Please fix this for 5 stars.

Amazing app to help with anxiety! I'm using this app at the moment to help with my anxiety. There's a questionnaire at the start to assess your symptoms and needs atm. Then comes up with a personalised plan with you. You set goals, there's brilliant activities available like guided breathing, Thought defusion, PMR, and a daily tracker for how your feeling. I've found it really helpful and I look forward to doing it every day!

I did not expect but I was very impressed especially when I first opened the app. I was able to talk to Allie, which I also found very cute, and also have some free features to use. I am kind of sad when I thought that the program(?) was free. But it doesn't matter. This beautiful app deserves all those subscriptions. It took me couple of months looking for a good app but I think I'll definitely use this one for a long time.
